decisions.reason: After remaining in the assortment through 2024, this close-to-core biodynamic yogurt appears to fit the firm’s established capabilities and customer base, so with uncertainty reduced and likely low continuation cost it remains worth keeping.
As a 2024 launch in a familiar cheese category, the product is still in the option-learning phase and can likely stay on the market at modest incremental cost while demand becomes clearer.

This is another very recent, close-to-established sliced cheese extension, and given the growing market and the firm’s broad range it is sensible to keep the option open until more evidence on its value emerges.
